reason: The lab report is what I look for and it is a good sign, but $25 to $30 a month is a lot on my budget when I can get magnesium glycinate for half that. A brand with no reviews yet is not where I spend extra.
objection: Why pay double for one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule for less, and this brand has no reviews I can read yet?
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 a month, plus a bunch of real buyer reviews and a lab report I can actually open and check before ordering.
